data.title: Transcenta Shareholders Approve Refreshed Share Incentive Scheme Limits
data.description:
Transcenta Holding Limited ( (HK:6628) ) has provided an announcement.

Transcenta Holding Limited, registered by way of continuation in the Cayman Islands with limited liability, announced the poll results of its extraordinary general meeting held on November 19, 2026. The meeting approved, by 100% of votes cast, refreshing the Share Incentive Scheme’s overall mandate limit to 3% of issued shares excluding treasury shares, subject to the Listing Rules.

A second resolution, conditional on the first, also passed unanimously, refreshing the Service Provider Sublimit to 0.6% of issued shares excluding treasury shares. In total, 149,574,418 votes were cast for each resolution and none against; 2,516,500 treasury shares were excluded from voting.

data.title: Ganfeng Lithium Proposes RMB200 Million-RMB400 Million A-Share Repurchase
data.description:
Ganfeng Lithium Co ( (HK:1772) ) has issued an announcement.

Ganfeng Lithium Group Co., Ltd., a China-incorporated joint-stock company listed under stock code 1772, proposed repurchasing RMB-denominated A shares through centralized bidding using its own or self-raised funds. The repurchase is intended to safeguard the company’s value and shareholders’ interests, with funding of RMB200 million to RMB400 million and a maximum price of RMB57.47 per share; the company estimates that the program would cover approximately 0.17% to 0.33% of issued share capital.

The repurchase is to be implemented within three months after Board approval. Repurchased shares are to be sold after 12 months from disclosure of the implementation results and within three years thereafter, with any remaining unsold shares subject to cancellation and registered-capital reduction procedures.

data.title: Rainmed Board Resolves June 29 to Enforce Target Performance Guarantee
data.description:
An announcement from Rainmed Medical Limited ( (HK:2297) ) is now available.

Rainmed Medical Limited said Tianjin Yuehekang Biotechnology Co., in which the Group acquired a 57% equity interest and subscribed for increased registered capital, failed to meet revenue and profit guarantees covering 2023-2025. Actual aggregate revenue was RMB20,118,035 against RMB60 million guaranteed, while net profit was negative RMB17,158,734 against RMB6.7 million guaranteed.

The Board resolved on June 29, 2026 to enforce the performance guarantee obligations. Under the investment agreement, the guarantors are required to pay full cash compensation of RMB25,960,000, equal to the Group’s total consideration for the acquisition and capital subscription.

data.title: Zijin Mining Board Approves Plan to Repurchase A Shares
data.description:
Zijin Mining Group Co ( (HK:2899) ) has issued an announcement.

Zijin Mining Group Co., Ltd. said its board approved a plan on 19 November 2026 to repurchase RMB-denominated A shares through centralised price bidding. The plan provides for funds of RMB2 billion to RMB3 billion, a maximum price of RMB35 per share and a repurchase period of no more than 12 months, funded with self-owned or self-raised funds.

The repurchased shares are designated for the company’s employee stock ownership scheme or share incentives, while shares not used within three years after the results announcement are to be cancelled. Under the company’s articles, board approval was sufficient and shareholder approval was not required for the plan.

data.title: China Approves United Laboratories’ UBT48128 Clinical Trial
data.description:
The United Laboratories International Holdings ( (HK:3933) ) just unveiled an update.

The United Laboratories International Holdings operates in the biopharmaceutical industry, develops pharmaceutical products and focuses on chronic disease treatment. China’s National Medical Products Administration approved a clinical trial for UBT48128 Tablets, a Class 1 new drug developed by the company’s wholly owned subsidiary, for overweight or obesity.

UBT48128 is a once-daily oral small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist that promotes insulin secretion, regulates appetite and modulates energy metabolism. The company said preclinical studies showed weight reduction exceeding control groups, and the U.S. Food and Drug Administration approved the product’s Investigational New Drug application on 11 August 2026.

data.title: Sunshine Oilsands Updates Investors on Alberta Court Judgment
data.description:
The latest update is out from Sunshine Oilsands ( (HK:2012) ).

Sunshine Oilsands Ltd. is an Alberta-incorporated company listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. The release does not specify its industry, primary products, services or market focus.

The Alberta Court of King’s Bench judgment, received on October 28, does not transfer legal ownership of the relevant assets but gives the Orphan Well Association powers to take over, manage and deal with them under court supervision. Sunshine Oilsands filed a notice of appeal on October 30; no hearing date is set, and the company says the appeal’s prospects face material uncertainty due to complex legal issues, arrears and the court’s discretionary powers.

data.title: Walnut Capital Proposes Eight-for-One Share Consolidation
data.description:
Walnut Capital Limited ( (HK:0905) ) has provided an announcement.

Walnut Capital Limited has proposed consolidating every eight issued and unissued shares of HK$0.01 each into one share of HK$0.08 each. The proposal requires shareholder approval at a special general meeting and remains conditional, so it may not proceed.

If effective, the board lot would change from 16,000 existing shares to 2,000 consolidated shares, in line with stated Main Board trading requirements. Based on the cited closing price, the theoretical consolidated-share price would be HK$2, while the estimated value of each revised board lot would be HK$4,000, versus HK$32,000 for a 16,000-share consolidated lot.
